text_block_list.text: A fan letter arrived for T.M. Opera O.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: This is wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Look here, Trainer-kun!
A devoted fan drew a portrait of me!

What she showed me
appeared to be a drawing
made by a child with crayons.

A stick figure with ears and a tail that looks
vaguely like T.M. Opera O is surrounded by
heavy scribbles of indigo crayon.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A slender, statuesque frame, charming ears
and a tail that utterly captivate the eye—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To capture my charm with such exquisite fidelity...
What an extraordinary genius the world possesses!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Besides... hmm, I see.
So this deep indigo represents the cosmos.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nice, a vision of me racing across the galaxy!
This kid's got incredible taste!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well then, I must answer that request as well!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, is there any effective training
for running in outer space!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'm always dead serious.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: If there are expectations, I simply must live up to them. You never know anything until you try, right?

...For now, I shared some astronaut training exercises
that could actually be done here at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, isn't this the usual menu...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp?! Wait a second?!
So that means—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Was I unconsciously practicing special training
to reach the pinnacle of the universe?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha!!
As expected of me, not the slightest oversight!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we take a step toward space?
All to grant that girl's wish!

As always, T.M. Opera O declared with
unwavering eyes.
